`schema.json` is the official MCP 2025-11-25 JSON Schema from
https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/38c84e9f93ad191d9eb26d92b945d17bd0efcaf3/schema/2025-11-25/schema.json.
It is distributed under the accompanying MIT license. Tests validate transport
messages and their initialize, tool list, tool result, notification, and elicitation
payloads against these definitions without network access.
